title: TTF/HH ratio spike shorts LNG 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] TTF/HH ratio 20d z-score > 1.0 leads LNG returns negatively (-) as the arb spike mean-reverts over 5 days; trade short LNG 5d [finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub -> finance.LNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0036)
message: Not supported: TTF/HH ratio z>1 vs LNG r=+0.14 at lag 0 (n=389), sign opposite to hypothesis; short-LNG rule loses pre-war (29 trades, -0.2%/trade), only war-period OOS positive (15 trades). Actionability 6.94 is not backed by validity (0).

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short LNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
